## Step 1: preparing the data

```{r}
raw_counts <- read.table("PATH", 
                         header = TRUE, 
                         row.names = 1, 
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                         check.names = FALSE)

colnames(raw_counts) <- gsub("\\.genes\\.results", "", colnames(raw_counts))

colnames(raw_counts) <- gsub("-", ".", colnames(raw_counts))

colnames(raw_counts) <- gsub("_$", "", colnames(raw_counts))
counts_data <- round(raw_counts)

colData <- read.csv('/home/akos/Desktop/lab/Föt/sample_info.csv', 
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, 
                    row.names = 1)

all(colnames(counts_data) %in% rownames(colData))

```

```{r}

keep_samples <- colData$Condition %in% c("CTR", "TIS", "REPOP")
colData_filtered <- colData[keep_samples, , drop=FALSE]

counts_data_filtered <- counts_data[, rownames(colData_filtered)]

colData_filtered$Condition <- droplevels(factor(colData_filtered$Condition))
colData_filtered$Condition <- relevel(colData_filtered$Condition, ref = "CTR")

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_data_filtered, 
                              colData = colData_filtered, 
                              design = ~ Condition)                              

keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= ncol(counts_data_filtered) * 5 
dds <- dds[keep,] 


dds <- DESeq(dds) 

fl0_res <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="Condition_TIS_vs_CTR", type="apeglm") 
```

```{r}
draw_colnames_45 <- function(coln, gaps, ...) {
  coord <- pheatmap:::find_coordinates(length(coln), gaps)
  x     <- coord$coord - 0.5 * coord$size
  res   <- textGrob(coln, x = x,
                    y = unit(1, "npc") - unit(3, "bigpts"),
                    vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, rot = 45,
                    gp = gpar(...))
  return(res)
}
assignInNamespace(x = "draw_colnames", value = "draw_colnames_45",
                  ns = asNamespace("pheatmap"))

makeColorRampPalette <- function(colors, cutoff.fraction, num.colors.in.palette) {
  stopifnot(length(colors) == 3)
  ramp1 <- colorRampPalette(colors[1:2])(num.colors.in.palette * cutoff.fraction)
  ramp2 <- colorRampPalette(colors[2:3])(num.colors.in.palette * (1 - cutoff.fraction))
  return(c(ramp1, ramp2))
}

my_similarity_heatmap <- function(dist_matrix, anno_var, anno_label, cutoffthres, title) {
  dist_matrix          <- as.matrix(dist_matrix)
  annotation           <- data.frame(group = anno_var)
  rownames(annotation) <- rownames(dist_matrix)
  colnames(annotation)[1] <- as.character(anno_label)

  group        <- c("#bc8f8f", "#698B69", "#6495ed")
  names(group) <- levels(anno_var)
  anno_colors  <- list(group = group)
  names(anno_colors) <- anno_label

  cutoff.distance <- max(dist_matrix) / cutoffthres
  cols <- makeColorRampPalette(
    c("#b35806", "white", "#542788"),
    cutoff.distance / max(dist_matrix),
    1000
  )

  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat                      = dist_matrix,
    color                    = cols,
    border_color             = NA,
    show_colnames            = TRUE,
    show_rownames            = TRUE,
    annotation_col           = annotation,
    annotation_row           = annotation,
    annotation_colors        = anno_colors,
    cluster_rows             = TRUE,
    cluster_cols             = TRUE,
    treeheight_row           = 0,
    clustering_method        = "complete",
    clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
    clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
    drop_levels              = TRUE,
    fontsize                 = 9,
    fontsize_row             = 10,
    main                     = title
  )
}

# --- rlog transformation ---
rld <- rlog(dds, blind = TRUE)

conditions <- colData_filtered$Condition

clean_names <- ave(
  as.character(conditions),
  conditions,
  FUN = function(x) {
    prefix <- dplyr::case_when(
      x[1] == "CTR"   ~ "ctr",
      x[1] == "TIS"   ~ "tis",
      x[1] == "REPOP" ~ "repop",
      TRUE             ~ tolower(x[1])
    )
    paste0(prefix, "_", seq_along(x))
  }
)


colnames(rld) <- clean_names

condition_factor <- factor(conditions, levels = c("CTR", "TIS", "REPOP"))
names(condition_factor) <- clean_names

# --- Pearson correlation heatmap ---
mat_cor      <- cor(assay(rld), method = "pearson")
mat_cor_dist <- as.dist(1 - mat_cor)

my_similarity_heatmap(
  dist_matrix = mat_cor_dist,
  anno_var    = condition_factor,
  anno_label  = "id",
  cutoffthres = 1.55,
  title       = "After Gene Filtering (Pearson corralation)"
)
```

```{r}
my_volcano_clean <- function(results_deseq, 
                             lfc_thres  = 1,
                             plot_title = NULL,
                             label_fc   = 2,      
                             label_padj = 1e-50, 
                             top_n      = 20,
                             fc_label   = "TIS/CTR") {   
  
  df <- results_deseq %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sig_color = dplyr::case_when(
        log2FoldChange >  lfc_thres ~ "up",
        log2FoldChange < -lfc_thres ~ "down",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      ),
      neg_log10_padj = -log10(padj)
    )
  
  label_up <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(log2FoldChange > label_fc, padj < label_padj) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(neg_log10_padj, n = ceiling(top_n / 2))
  
  label_down <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(log2FoldChange < -label_fc, padj < label_padj) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(neg_log10_padj, n = floor(top_n / 2))
  
  label_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(label_up, label_down)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_padj)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = sig_color), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("up" = "#D85A30", "down" = "#378ADD", "ns" = "#888780")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thres, lfc_thres),
               col = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
               col = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data               = label_df,
      aes(label          = gene_name),
      size               = 4.5,              # Gene label size INCREASED (3.2 -> 4.5)
      color              = "black",
      fontface           = "italic",
      box.padding        = 0.5,      
      point.padding      = 0.3,      
      force              = 3,        
      force_pull         = 0.5,
      max.overlaps       = Inf,      
      segment.size       = 0.3,
      segment.color      = "grey40",
      min.segment.length = 0.2,
      direction          = "y",
      nudge_x            = ifelse(label_df$log2FoldChange > 0, 1.5, -1.5)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-12, 12), breaks = seq(-10, 10, 5)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))) +
    labs(
      x     = bquote(log[2]*"FC ("*.(fc_label)*")"),
      y     = expression(-log[10]*"(Adjusted p-value)"),
      title = plot_title
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +          # Base font size INCREASED (12 -> 16)
    theme(
      legend.position  = "none",
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black", size = 14), # Axis tick label size
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 16),                  # Axis title size
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),   # Title size INCREASED (13 -> 18)
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#DDDDDD", linewidth = 0.2)
    )
}

# Run as before:
target_df <- as.data.frame(fl0_res_df) 
target_clean <- target_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange))

p <- my_volcano_clean(
  results_deseq = target_clean,
  lfc_thres  = 1,
  label_fc   = 2,      
  label_padj = 1e-50, 
  top_n      = 20,
  plot_title = "MCF7: TIS vs CTR"
)
print(p)
ggsave("volcano_plot_MCF7.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")     

```
## GSEA

```{r}
plot_gsea_dotplot <- function(gsea_res, source_label = NULL, contrast_label = NULL, showCategory = 10) {
  
  if (is.null(contrast_label)) {
    contrast_label <- source_label
  }
  
  df <- as.data.frame(gsea_res)
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    message("No significant result (", contrast_label, ")")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  df$Count <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(df$core_enrichment), "/"), length)
  df$GeneRatioNum <- df$Count / as.numeric(df$setSize)
  df$.sign <- ifelse(df$NES > 0, "activated", "suppressed")
  
  df_up   <- df %>% dplyr::filter(.sign == "activated")  %>% dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>% head(showCategory)
  df_down <- df %>% dplyr::filter(.sign == "suppressed") %>% dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>% head(showCategory)
  df_plot <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_up, df_down)
  
  df_plot <- df_plot %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(.sign), GeneRatioNum)
  df_plot$Description <- factor(df_plot$Description, levels = unique(df_plot$Description))
  df_plot$.sign <- factor(df_plot$.sign, levels = c("suppressed", "activated"))
  
  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = GeneRatioNum, y = Description)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = Count, fill = p.adjust), shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d76565", high = "#5c81ab", name = "p.adjust", trans = "log10") +
    guides(
      fill = guide_colorbar(order = 1, reverse = TRUE),
      size = guide_legend(order = 2, title = "Count")
    ) +
    facet_grid(. ~ .sign) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("MCF7: ", contrast_label),
      x = "GeneRatio",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.45))) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y          = element_text(lineheight = 0.9, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.position      = c(0.98, 0.02),
      legend.justification = c(1, 0),
      legend.box           = "horizontal",
      
      # Single, final background definition for the black frame
      legend.background  = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.9), color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
      
      # Wider keys so that the bold title does not extend beyond the frame
      legend.key.width   = unit(0.9, "cm"), 
      legend.key.height  = unit(0.5, "cm"), 
      
      legend.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.text        = element_text(),
      
      # Single, final margin and spacing settings
      legend.margin      = margin(4, 4, 4, 4),
      legend.spacing.x   = unit(0.3, "cm")
    )
  print(p)
  return(p)
}

```

df <- fl0_res_df 


df_clean <- df[!is.na(df$gene_name), ]

df_unique <- df_clean[order(df_clean$padj), ]

gene_list <- sort(na.omit(gene_list), decreasing = TRUE)

### KEGG

```{r}
ids <- bitr(names(gene_list), 
            fromType = "SYMBOL", 
            toType   = "ENTREZID", 
            OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db)

dedup_ids <- ids[!duplicated(ids[c("SYMBOL")]),]

kegg_df <- data.frame(SYMBOL = names(gene_list), LFC = as.numeric(gene_list))
kegg_df <- kegg_df[kegg_df$SYMBOL %in% dedup_ids$SYMBOL,]
kegg_df$ENTREZID <- dedup_ids$ENTREZID[match(kegg_df$SYMBOL, dedup_ids$SYMBOL)]

kegg_gene_list <- kegg_df$LFC
names(kegg_gene_list) <- kegg_df$ENTREZID
kegg_gene_list <- sort(kegg_gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)

kk2 <- gseKEGG(geneList     = kegg_gene_list,
               organism     = "hsa",
               minGSSize    = 10,
               maxGSSize    = 500,
               pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
               verbose      = FALSE, 
               pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
               keyType      = "ncbi-geneid")
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# 1. Extracting the REPOP vs TIS results
# ==========================================
# TIS is set as the reference level
dds$Condition <- relevel(dds$Condition, ref = "TIS")

# Re-run the test with the new reference
dds <- nbinomWaldTest(dds)

# Extract the log2FoldChange values for the REPOP vs TIS contrast
repop_tis_res <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="Condition_REPOP_vs_TIS", type="apeglm") 
repop_tis_df <- as.data.frame(repop_tis_res)

# ==========================================
# 2. Assigning gene names (SYMBOL)
# ==========================================
gen_ids_rt <- rownames(repop_tis_df)
gen_clean_rt <- gsub("\\..*", "", gen_ids_rt)

gene_map_rt <- ensembldb::select(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86, 
                                 keys = gen_clean_rt, 
                                 keytype = "GENEID", 
                                 columns = c("GENEID", "SYMBOL"))

# Remove duplicates
gene_map_rt <- gene_map_rt[!duplicated(gene_map_rt$GENEID), ]

repop_tis_df$gene_name <- gene_map_rt$SYMBOL[match(gen_clean_rt, gene_map_rt$GENEID)]
repop_tis_df$gene_name[is.na(repop_tis_df$gene_name)] <- gen_ids_rt[is.na(repop_tis_df$gene_name)]

# ==========================================
# 3. Filtering the data and drawing the volcano plot
# ==========================================
target_clean_rt <- repop_tis_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange))

p_rt <- my_volcano_clean(
  results_deseq = target_clean_rt,
  lfc_thres  = 1,
  label_fc   = 2,      
  label_padj = 1e-50, 
  top_n      = 20,
  plot_title = "MCF7: REPOP vs TIS",
  fc_label   = "REPOP/TIS"
)

print(p_rt)

# Save the figure
ggsave("volcano_plot_REPOP_vs_TIS.png", plot = p_rt, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
df_clean_rt <- repop_tis_df[!is.na(repop_tis_df$gene_name), ]
df_unique_rt <- df_clean_rt[order(df_clean_rt$padj), ] 
df_unique_rt <- df_unique_rt[!duplicated(df_unique_rt$gene_name), ] 

# Build the LFC-based vector
gene_list_rt <- df_unique_rt$log2FoldChange
names(gene_list_rt) <- df_unique_rt$gene_name
gene_list_rt <- sort(na.omit(gene_list_rt), decreasing = TRUE)

# SYMBOL -> ENTREZID conversion
ids_rt <- bitr(names(gene_list_rt), 
               fromType = "SYMBOL", 
               toType   = "ENTREZID", 
               OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db)

dedup_ids_rt <- ids_rt[!duplicated(ids_rt$SYMBOL), ]

kegg_df_rt <- data.frame(SYMBOL = names(gene_list_rt), LFC = as.numeric(gene_list_rt))
kegg_df_rt <- kegg_df_rt[kegg_df_rt$SYMBOL %in% dedup_ids_rt$SYMBOL, ]
kegg_df_rt$ENTREZID <- dedup_ids_rt$ENTREZID[match(kegg_df_rt$SYMBOL, dedup_ids_rt$SYMBOL)]

# Final ENTREZID-based list, sorted in decreasing order
kegg_gene_list_rt <- kegg_df_rt$LFC
names(kegg_gene_list_rt) <- kegg_df_rt$ENTREZID
kegg_gene_list_rt <- sort(kegg_gene_list_rt, decreasing = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# 1. Extracting the CTR vs REPOP results
# ==========================================
# (added: restore the CTR reference level, otherwise the Condition_REPOP_vs_CTR coefficient does not exist)
dds$Condition <- relevel(dds$Condition, ref = "CTR")
dds <- nbinomWaldTest(dds)

# Extract the log2FoldChange values for the REPOP vs CTR contrast with lfcShrink
repop_res <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="Condition_REPOP_vs_CTR", type="apeglm") 
repop_res_df <- as.data.frame(repop_res)

# ==========================================
# 2. Assigning gene names (SYMBOL)
# ==========================================
gen_ids_repop <- rownames(repop_res_df)
gen_clean_repop <- gsub("\\..*", "", gen_ids_repop)

gene_map_repop <- ensembldb::select(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86, 
                                    keys = gen_clean_repop, 
                                    keytype = "GENEID", 
                                    columns = c("GENEID", "SYMBOL"))

# Remove duplicates
gene_map_repop <- gene_map_repop[!duplicated(gene_map_repop$GENEID), ]

repop_res_df$gene_name <- gene_map_repop$SYMBOL[match(gen_clean_repop, gene_map_repop$GENEID)]
repop_res_df$gene_name[is.na(repop_res_df$gene_name)] <- gen_ids_repop[is.na(repop_res_df$gene_name)]
```
